column3: Close to the Hebrew; מַשָּׂא (“oracle”) is rendered “The burden against,” “from entering” “no harbor,” and מֵאֶרֶץ כִּתִּים (Kittim) “Cyprus.”
Close to the Hebrew; “be silent” is rendered “Be still.”
Close to the Hebrew; “seed” is rendered “grain,” and “traffic” “a marketplace.”
Close to the Hebrew; the past “I have not labored” is rendered as present “I do not labor,” and “young women” “virgins.”
Close to the Hebrew; “which bestows crowns” is rendered “the crowning city,” and “traders” and “merchants” are swapped.
Close to the Hebrew; “pass over” is rendered “Overflow,” and “no restraint” “no more strength.”
Close to the Hebrew; “desert-dwellers” is rendered “wild beasts of the desert,” and “stripped bare” “raised up.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the prostitute” is rendered “the harlot.”
Close to the Hebrew; “act as a prostitute” is rendered “commit fornication,” and “kingdoms of the earth” “kingdoms of the world.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a holy thing” is rendered “set apart,” and “covering magnificent” “fine clothing.”
